_comment: Vendor-only, for the licence tool's Cloudflare automation. Copy to cloudflare-config.json (gitignored) and fill in. ApiToken needs: Account > Cloudflare Tunnel = Edit, and Zone (bhodhix.com) > DNS = Edit. AccountId and ZoneId are on the Cloudflare dashboard (Overview/API section). Service is where the app listens on each host.
